versions.content: Service Name Bmc_FetchXor_u Syntax Bmc_AtomicUType Bmc_FetchXor_u ( volatile Bmc_AtomicUType * Object, Bmc_AtomicUType Operand ) Service ID [hex] 0x80 to 0x83 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Operand Value for the operation Parameters (inout) Object Object Parameters (out) None Return value Bmc_AtomicUType The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects Description Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the result of the xor-operation applied to the value pointed to by Object and the given Operand. Available via Bmc.h
